<!--
  Features as cards under a centered heading. Axes: item (picture: a picture on top, then the title, the text
  and a read link; panel: a muted panel with a large glyph on top, then the title and the text), cols (3, 4),
  tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

export type FeatureShowcaseProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  features: Feature[];
  more: string;
  item?: "picture" | "panel";
  cols?: "3" | "4";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Card from "../primitives/card/card.vue";
import CardContent from "../primitives/card/card-content.vue";
import Link from "../primitives/link/link.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  features,
  more,
  item = "picture",
  cols = "3",
  tone = "default",
} = defineProps<FeatureShowcaseProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :lead="lead" :tone="tone" align="center">
    <Box
      :class="
        (cols as string) === '4' ? 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 text-start sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4'
        : 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 text-start sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3'
      "
    >
      <Card
        v-for="f in features"
        :key="f.id"
        variant="default"
        class="h-full gap-4 overflow-hidden"
        data-testid="showcase-card"
      >
        <MediaFrame v-if="((item as string) === 'picture')" :alt="f.title" ratio="16/9" />
        <Box v-else
          class="flex aspect-video items-center justify-center rounded bg-muted text-foreground"
          data-testid="showcase-panel"
        >
          <LucideIcon :name="f.icon" :size="32" />
        </Box>
        <CardContent class="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
          <Title :as="3" size="base" weight="semibold">
            {{ f.title }}
          </Title>
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ f.text }}
          </Text>
          <Link v-if="((item as string) === 'picture')" href="#/" size="sm" class="mt-auto pt-2" data-testid="read">
            {{ more }}
            <LucideIcon name="arrow-right" :size="16" />
          </Link>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </Box>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
